messages.subject: CPD webinar: Drafting and negotiating IP licences (3 Dec)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Colleague,

You are invited to our December CPD webinar, 'Drafting and negotiating IP licences: royalties, field restrictions and improvements', on Wednesday 3 December at 12:30. The session qualifies for 1.5 CPD hours and is free for firm subscribers.

Register via the link in your member portal. Recordings will be available afterwards.

Westminster Legal Training
